mapper.sql: FROM activities a JOIN follows f ON f.following_id = a.user_id AND f.follower_id = #{me} JOIN users u ON u.id = a.user_id AND u.status = 'ACTIVE' LEFT JOIN analyses an ON a.type = 'ANALYSIS' AND an.id = a.target_id AND an.user_id = a.user_id LEFT JOIN concept_reviews r ON a.type = 'REVIEW' AND r.id = a.target_id AND r.user_id = a.user_id LEFT JOIN concepts rc ON rc.id = r.concept_id LEFT JOIN concept_wishes w ON a.type = 'WISH' AND w.user_id = a.user_id AND w.concept_id = a.target_id LEFT JOIN concepts wc ON wc.id = w.concept_id LEFT JOIN posts p ON a.type = 'POST' AND p.id = a.target_id AND p.user_id = a.user_id LEFT JOIN challenges ch ON a.type IN ('CHALLENGE_JOIN', 'CHALLENGE_COMPLETE') AND ch.id = a.target_id WHERE (a.type = 'ANALYSIS' AND an.is_public = TRUE AND an.status = 'DONE' AND an.deleted_at IS NULL) OR (a.type = 'REVIEW' AND rc.status = 'PUBLISHED') OR (a.type = 'WISH' AND wc.status = 'PUBLISHED') OR (a.type = 'POST' AND p.id IS NOT NULL) OR (a.type IN ('CHALLENGE_JOIN', 'CHALLENGE_COMPLETE') AND ch.id IS NOT NULL)
mapper.select:
SELECT a.id, a.type, a.created_at, u.id AS actor_id, u.nickname AS actor_nickname, CASE WHEN a.type = 'REVIEW' THEN r.concept_id ELSE a.target_id END AS target_id, CASE a.type WHEN 'ANALYSIS' THEN COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(an.title), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(an.project_name), '')) WHEN 'REVIEW' THEN rc.name WHEN 'WISH' THEN wc.name WHEN 'POST' THEN p.title ELSE ch.title END AS target_title, r.rating AS target_rating
ORDER BY a.created_at DESC, a.id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
